description: İstanbul Deniz Yüzeyinden Temizlenen Atık Verileri is a dataset listed in Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality open data portal, a city open data portal (CKAN), published or maintained by İstanbul İstatistik Ofisi. Veri seti, İstanbul genelinde deniz yüzeyinden temizlenen m3 ve kg cinsinden aylık atık verilerini içermektedir. Coverage: İstanbul İstatistik Ofisi. The publisher named on the listing is İstanbul İstatistik Ofisi. Its keywords include atık, deniz, istaç, yüzey, çöp. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2025-03-07 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality Open Data License. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-ibb-gov-tr.
